claim: Previous quadruped RL work required 12-120 hours of training; Rudin et al. reduce this to under 20 minutes — representing multiple orders of magnitude speedup.
stance_target: massively parallel GPU-based RL dramatically reduces locomotion training time vs. earlier approaches
scope_conditions: Comparison to Lee et al. (12 hours), Kumar et al. (82/88 hours), Miki et al. (120 hours)
quoted_support: we can train a perceptive policy in under 20 minutes on a single GPU... Perceptive locomotion has been achieved... (12 hours of training)... (82 and 88 hours of training)... (120 hours of training).
